BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Torexesa!!
Mare!
She's my sister, Mera. She's a councilor...
What brings you here?
We helped them when they were being attacked by a\ndragon. We told them we wanna form an alliance\nwith the Ranas, then they took us here...
Attacked by a dragon?! Mare!!
How many times have I told you to stop doing\ndangerous things and just help me with my work...
Do you really expect me to swallow my pride as a\nwarrior to become your assistant?!
I'm sorry you had to see that...\nLet me introduce you to the council members.\nFollow me this way...
...Therefore, we have come to request you to\nconsider forming an alliance with the Eumanos...
Hmm, forming an alliance with another race is one\noption to protect people from various threats,\nbut...
I apologize if I'm being very rude to the envoys\nwho have come all the way to Aquacity, but...
It's difficult for us to trust another race,\nespecially when each of you looks different.
That's really rude! But I can understand.\nWell, it won't get us anywhere even if we go on\ntalking. What should we do to gain your trust?
Hmm...Recently, there are signs that someone has\nbroken into the city dome which is a district that\nhas been abandoned...
We may consider it if you can get rid of that\nintruder...
To see whether you can cooperate with us or not,\nwe'll ask some Rana warriors to go with you.
If you can get rid of the intruder and come back\nwithout losing a single warrior, we'll form an\nalliance with you. What do you say?
Okay, no problem! I'll make you form an alliance\nwith us at all costs!
All right, we'll pick the warriors to go with\nyou, please wait for a while...
I'm sorry you had to see that earlier...
It seems like you and your sister don't get along\nvery well, do you?
Good to see you here. Go with them to the\nabandoned district. This has been decided by\nthe council.
What?! Why?!\nWhy would you make your sister do such a\ndangerous thing?!
Yeah, you just scolded her and told her to stop\ndoing dangerous things, and now you want her to go\nto a dangerous place...
Yeah, you just scolded her and told her to stop\ndoing dangerous things, and now you want her to go\nto a dangerous place...Wait, is it dangerous?!
Okay, I'll go with them to the abandoned district.
Sorry, but we can't breathe in the water...\nDo you have a solution?
Hm? O-oh, in that case...
This stone is called Oxystone. It will cover your\nbody with oxygen and allow you to breathe in\nthe water. Here you go...
Please make sure that Mare and Aga are safe...
Don't worry! We'll do everything we can to\nprotect them!
You won't agree to form an alliance if they don't\ncome back safely with us, right? We'll bring them\nback without a scratch, so don't worry!!
You told the councilors that the Profundos who\nhave lost their homes are in the Abandoned\nDistrict and proposed to let them stay for now...
It's hard to believe that the Profundos who have\nlived and settled in the deep sea have appeared...
But there is no doubt that something is happening \nin the deep sea of Aqua Gota...
Since they were forced to leave their homes, they\nmust be struggling too right now. They may stay in\nthe Abandoned District temporarily...
...And you're deemed trustworthy since you solved\nthe issue in the Abandoned District. We've decided\nto form an alliance with the Eumanos!
Yay! This means there's nothing to fear anymore!!
What? You want me to go back to Erva Tronc?\nB-but, unsettling things are still happening\naround here, how can I just...
Huh?! Someone needs to inform Kinda about the\nalliance agreement. If you don't go back,\nthe Eumanos won't come to help us, you know?
T-that's right! I need to report it to our leader\nand bring in the reinforcements!! I got it,\nI'll leave the rest to you then!
Oh, sorry, I know you just came back, but I would\nlike you to go check what's happening in the deep\nsea...
Whaaat?!\nCan you please stop making us do that kind of\nwork? Ask someone else~!
Please don't look so displeased...If the\ninvestigation goes smoothly, we can establish a\ntrade route between the outside world and Ranas.
Really?! Lying and bluffing is a no-go, you know!\nIf you say so, let's go!\nC'mon, let's go!!
Mare, Aga, please continue to accompany them.\nI'll let you choose the other warriors to go with\nyou. Is that okay?
But why Miss Mera? What's your plan?! Why do you\nkeep making your own sister carry out a dangerous\ntask?!
It's fine if you don't wanna go...\nI understand what I should do.
T-that's not what I mean, Miss Mare!! I just\ncouldn't stand it because Miss Mera was being so\nheartless...
I have prepared myself to follow you wherever\nyou go!
Mera!!
Don't move! Unless you want this gal dead!!
Coenubia!!\nFlammel! Is this the disturbing presence you\nmentioned earlier?!
Yeah, it seems so. It looks like he's managed to\nhide his presence quite well. Because even I could\nbarely sense it...
I was planning to stay quiet until the Humida army\nlaunched their attack here, but since you already\nknow now, I'll just...
Ugh?!
Now!!
Grr, you wretch!
Argh!!
This is unforgivable!!
Thank god, we managed to save her somehow...
Miss Mare, I'm glad that we were able to stop\nCoenubia's major aggression too.
Yeah...
Mare, I need to apologize to you...
Actually...These two have been taking advantage of\nthe council's indifference toward the warriors by\nassigning numerous tasks to you so that the other
warriors get jealous. They wanted to divide you...\nPlease forgive me for passing on their orders all\nthis time without ever suspecting them...
It takes time to break the awkward tension...But\nI think she got the message, so let's take it\nslow, okay?
V-Vasaria...!!
Long time no see. I didn't know that you also came\nto this world...
H-ha...haha!!
I...I wonder how much the other gods fear\nVasaria...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing!
